ops.en: THE SEVENTH SUMMONS [EX10-12]. BO el-paro — 'COME to Pharaoh': and the Kitzur reads the dispatch-grammar whole — 'to his HOUSE, He says COME; to the WATER, He says GO' — the file verified across the cycle (asserted): three house-summonses all bo (7:26, 9:1, here), three river-and-morning stations all lekh or hashkem (7:15, 8:16, 9:13) — the machine's own errand-formula distinction attested from th…

THE DELIVERY. va-YAVO moshe ve-aharon el-paro VA-YOMRU elav — 'and Moses and Aaron CAME... and SAID': for the FIRST time in the cycle, the errand's delivery is NARRATED (asserted — the machine pops the card on-stage: the unnarrated-compliance class that held 7:15, 8:16, and 9:1 breaks its pattern exactly at the seventh summons; the corpus files the structural shift with the plague-count: as the cy…

THE THREAT [EX10-08 CROWN]. ki im-maen ata le-shaleach — the conditional-formula's fourth issue; hineni mevi machar ARBE BI- GVULEKHA — 'tomorrow I bring LOCUSTS into your BORDER': and the border-word carries the run's finest transmission-story — a genuine BOOKS-DIVIDED station resolved by the Torah's own law: the Ramah — 'two manuscripts write it full and four lean — and AFTER THE MANY WE INCLINE…

THE MENU. ve-KHISA et-EN ha-aretz — 'and it shall COVER the EYE of the land' (the cover-verb of 8:2's frog armed at the sea 14:28; the land's eye — the readings' surface-or-sun split, named-only); ve- akhal et-YETER HA-PLETA ha-nisheret lakhem MIN-HA-BARAD — 'the REMNANT of what ESCAPED... from the HAIL': the locust's menu is exactly 9:31-32's spared column (the wheat and spelt that were late — th…

THE LADDER'S THIRD RUNG. u-malu VATEKHA... asher LO-RAU AVOTEKHA va- avot avotekha — 'such as your FATHERS and your FATHERS' FATHERS have not seen': the superlative ladder's third rung (since-founding 9:18, since-nationhood 9:24, now the generations' memory — 11:6's never- again will finish it; the kaf of the all-words soft, MS, asserted [EX10-14]); va-YIFEN va-yetze me-im paro — 'and he TURNED an…

THE REVOLT. va-yomru avde faro elav — the SERVANTS press the king (the court's first open counter-counsel: the fearers of 9:20 now a faction); ad-matai yihye ZE lanu le-moqesh — 'how long shall THIS ONE be a SNARE': the this-word on Moses (the ze-file — 'this man Moses,' 32:1, the readings named [EX10-14]); SHALACH et-ha-anashim — the send-verb in EGYPTIAN mouths for the first time (the demand's v…

THE RECALL [EX10-02 CROWN]. va-YUSHAV moshe ve-aharon — 'and they were BROUGHT BACK' (the passive: the expelled negotiators fetched by the court that just revolted — asserted); lekhu ivdu... MI va-MI ha- HOLKHIM — 'WHO and who are THE ONES GOING?': the going-word written LEAN with all the precise books, and the Ramah's rule verified WHOLE (VERIFIED): every going-ones in the Torah lean — except ONE…

THE MANIFEST [EX10-09; EX10-13]. bi-NEARENU u-vi-ZQENENU nelekh — 'with our YOUNG and with our OLD we will go': the manifest carried on three ruled spellings (VERIFIED/asserted [EX10-09]): the youths- word FULL and the elders-word FULL against three doubting authorities (the Meiri, the old tikkun, Minchat Kohen — MS's fifth corrected authority of the run), and the daughters-word on its one INVERTE…

THE EXPULSION. lo khen — 'NOT SO': the king's counter-manifest — lekhu-na ha-GVARIM — 'the MEN [only]' (the gever-word against 10:9's whole-family list: the bargain-ladder's fourth rung — in-the-land, not-far, men-only; the flocks-rung waits at 10:24); ki ota atem MEVAQSHIM — 'for THAT is what you are seeking' (the soft qof of the seek-word, MS, asserted [EX10-14]; the readings on the king's foren…

THE COMMAND [EX10-03 CROWN]. NETE yadkha al-eretz mitzrayim BA-ARBE — 'STRETCH OUT your hand... FOR THE LOCUSTS'; ve-YOKHAL et-kol-esev ha-aretz — 'THAT IT MAY EAT every herb': the eat-word is the JUSSIVE — and the Torah's jussive eat-words number exactly THREE (VERIFIED by the vav's half-vowel): the locust's let-it-eat, Isaac's let-my- father-eat in Esau's mouth (Gen 27:31), and Reuel's call-him-…

THE WIND [EX10-14]. va-yet moshe et-matehu — the stretch performed, the card popped; va-YHWH NIHAG RUACH QADIM — 'and the LORD DROVE an EAST WIND' (the drive-verb nihag — the shepherd's word, 3:1's leading of the flock now on weather; MS rules the east-wind pair joined by the BINDER where the stream writes a space — the run's second binder-split, dual-tracked [EX10-14]); kol-ha-yom ha-hu ve- khol-…

THE RESTING [EX10-04 CROWN; EX10-14]. va-YANACH be-khol gevul mitzrayim — 'and it RESTED in all the border of Egypt': the rest- form's exact Torah-pair (VERIFIED; the deposit-form excluded by its doubled letter): the locust's resting here and the CREATOR'S on the seventh day (20:11 — the Sabbath-commandment's own verb): the Kitzur — 'the locust RESTED ON THE SABBATH,' and the fast-day law drawn fr…

THE DARKENING. va-yekhas et-EN kol-ha-aretz va-TECHSHAKH ha-aretz — 'it covered the eye of all the land, and the land was DARKENED': the darkness-verb debuts INSIDE the locust (plague nine previewed by plague eight — the machine files the overlap the letter writes); va- yokhal... et asher HOTIR ha-barad — the hail's leavings eaten (10:5's menu executed; 9:31-32's audit closed); ve-lo-notar kol- YE…

THE SECOND CONFESSION. va-YEMAHER paro liqro — 'and Pharaoh HURRIED to call': the hurry-verb on the throne (the plague's speed transferred — the readings, named-only); CHATATI la-YHWH elohekhem VE-LAKHEM — 'I have sinned against the LORD your God AND AGAINST YOU': the confession WIDENED from 9:27 (there the court-verdict; here the personal wrong to the deliverers added — the machine files the ledg…

THE FOURTH ENTREAT [EX10-05 CROWN]. sa-na chatati AKH HA-PAAM — 'forgive, pray, my sin ONLY THIS ONCE' (the once-word the ledger reads darkly: the throne itself now numbers its relapses); ve-HATIRU la-YHWH elohekhem — the entreat-demand's fourth issue; ve-YASER me- alai raq et-ha-MAVET ha-ze — 'that He REMOVE from me only this DEATH': the remove-word is the JUSSIVE — and the Torah's jussive remove…

THE KINGLESS VERSE [EX10-11 CROWN]. va-YETZE me-im paro va-yetar el- YHWH — 'and HE went out from Pharaoh, and entreated': the entreat- card pops — and the verse omits MOSES' NAME (VERIFIED: no moshe- token in the verse, against the named exits of the other plagues — 8:26's va-yetze MOSHE asserted): and MS carries the Masorah's mnemonic for the omission: MELEKH EN LA-ARBE — 'THE LOCUST HAS NO KING…

THE SEA DEBUTS. va-yahafokh YHWH RUACH-YAM — 'and the LORD TURNED a SEA-WIND' (the turn-verb on the weather: the east wind reversed); va-yitqaehu YAMA SUF — 'and THRUST them into the REED SEA': the Reed Sea enters the corpus (asserted — the first naming of the water where the cycle will end: the locusts drown in it four chapters before the chariots do, and the machine arms the geography: 13:18, 14…

THE SECOND STATION. va-yechazeq YHWH et-lev paro — the divine strengthening's second narrated station (9:12 the turn; now the policy routine — the machine files the tempo: after the eighth plague the hardening no longer needs a seal-formula or a spoken forecast: one clause, no commentary); ve-lo shilach et-bene yisrael — and the refusal-formula in its shortest form: the ledger runs on rails now, a…

THE NINTH COMMAND. NETE yadkha al-ha-shamayim — the heaven-stretch again (9:22's axis); vi-yhi CHOSHEKH al-eretz mitzrayim — 'and there shall be DARKNESS over the land of Egypt'; ve-YAMESH choshekh — 'and the darkness shall be FELT' (the touch-verb on the dark — the readings' thick-as-coin darkness, named-only): NO WARNING precedes (the third-of-the-triplet law complete: lice, boils, DARKNESS — th…

PLAGUE NINE. va-yet moshe et-yado al-ha-shamayim — the stretch performed, the card popped; va-yehi CHOSHEKH-AFELA be-khol-eretz mitzrayim SHLOSHET YAMIM — 'THICK DARKNESS... THREE DAYS': the doubled dark-word (choshekh-afela — the readings' darkness-upon- darkness, named-only) on the three-day clock (the three-days motif the corpus tracks: the journey asked at 3:18/5:3/8:23 returned as the plague'…

THE LIGHT [EX10-01 CROWN]. lo-rau ish et-achiv ve-lo-qamu ish mi- tachtav — 'no man SAW HIS BROTHER, nor rose from his place': the social darkness (the readings: the deepest dark is the unseen brother — named-only); u-le-khol bene yisrael haya OR be-MOSHVOTAM — 'but ALL the sons of Israel had LIGHT in their DWELLINGS': the distinction-file's summit (the swarms 8:18, the cattle 9:4, the hail 9:26, …

THE FIFTH BARGAIN. va-yiqra faro el-moshe — the summons from inside the dark (the soft pe of faro, MS, asserted [EX10-14]); lekhu ivdu et-YHWH RAQ tzonkhem u-veqarkhem YUTZAG — 'go, serve — ONLY your flocks and herds SHALL BE HELD BACK': the bargain-ladder's last rung (in-the-land, not-far, men-only, now flocks-stay — each concession keeping one hook); gam-tapkhem yelekh imakhem — 'your little one…

THE AUDACITY. GAM-ATA TITEN be-yadenu ZEVACHIM VE-OLOT — 'YOU YOURSELF will also GIVE into our hand sacrifices and burnt- offerings': the give-word demanded of the throne (the refuser of straw made the donor of offerings — the give-file's reversal); and the sacrifices-and-offerings adjacency carries its Scripture-twin at JEHU'S Baal-house (2 Kgs 10:24 — the Kitzur: 'as there he executed judgments …

THE UNWILLING. va-yechazeq YHWH et-lev paro — the divine strengthening's third station in-span; ve-LO AVA le-shalcham — 'and he was NOT WILLING to send them': the will-verb debuts in the refusal-formula (not the heavy heart, not the unhearing ear — the WILL itself named as the fault-line; the readings' seat-of-refusal, named-only): the machine notes the vocabulary's last escalation before the brea…

THE BAN [EX10-06 CROWN]. LEKH ME-ALAI — 'GO FROM ME' (me-alai in the cipher: ON PASSOVER — 'on Passover they went out,' named [EX10-14]); hishamer lekha AL-TOSEF REOT PANAI — 'do not AGAIN SEE MY FACE — for on the day you see my face YOU SHALL DIE': the throne's last demand, pushed as a death-ban — and the do-not-again frame stands exactly TWICE in the Torah (VERIFIED): Pharaoh's ban here, and 'DO…

KEN DIBARTA — 'you have spoken WELL' (the so-word of compliance handed back as irony: the ban is accepted as prophecy); LO-OSIF OD reot panekha — 'I will NOT AGAIN see your face': the ban-card POPS on the acceptance — and the not-again frame's exact pair (VERIFIED) is the FLOOD'S never-again ('I will NOT AGAIN smite every living thing,' Gen 8:21): the Kitzur — 'a hin…
